description: GetCapTableHealth answers "is anything wrong with this cap table?". It runs every server-side check over the stored cap table and returns the issues as data: authorized shares not set, a share class at or over its authorized count, SAFEs with no signed document, no terms or no stated type, a SAFE stack promised more than 100%, a priced round still open with all its money wired, and preferred stock with no liquidation terms. The web shows the same list. Read-only.
name: cap_table_get_cap_table_health
title: Get Cap Table Health
